segmenter.short_fragment_policy: merge with previous; prefix merges with next

pooling: Unit-normalize each mean/max pooled local vector; concatenate unit whole and local vectors divided by sqrt(2). Whole duplicate uses the same construction. Zero pooled norm falls back to whole.
selection_rule: Only mean/max candidates with strictly higher exact-set accuracy and no lower three-intent exact accuracy than whole are eligible; rank by exact_set_accuracy, micro_f1, micro_precision, earlier representation. Otherwise retain whole.
boundaries: Designed after the first pooling comparison and numerical audit; fixed before these matched strict-tolerance fits.
Same four representations and predictive selection rule; independent duplicate fits must agree on all selection label sets with score difference at most 0.001.
All heads use tol=1e-8, max_iter=5000, C=10, no class weighting, threshold=0.5 and seed=42.
No further grid, threshold, encoder, segmentation or pooling changes based on these outcomes.
Calibration, publisher-test payloads, Bitext test, private reviews and browser changes remain excluded.

numerical_control.failure_policy: Retain whole as reference and mark comparison unusable; no representation adoption
